target.title: fix(markdown-core): CJK-friendly emphasis flanking so **标签：**正文 renders bold (#101120)
target.body:
Fixes #101120

## What Problem This Solves

Bold written as `**标题：**内容` (full-width CJK punctuation immediately inside the closing `**`, no following space) renders as literal `**` on Telegram and every channel using the shared markdown renderer. CommonMark's flanking rules require a closing delimiter preceded by punctuation to be followed by whitespace/punctuation — but CJK text has no inter-word spaces, so the extremely common `**label：**text` idiom from CJK LLM output never qualifies.

## Fix

Small local amendment in `packages/markdown-core/src/ir.ts`: wraps markdown-it's inline delimiter scanning so East Asian characters adjacent to a delimiter count as letters for flanking (per the CJK-friendly flanking amendment semantics from markdown-it-cjk-friendly, implemented locally — **no new dependency**).

- Only activates when a CJK code point is adjacent to the delimiter run; ASCII/Latin behavior is unchanged CommonMark
- Whitespace-adjacent handling unchanged; `_` emphasis unchanged; code spans/links unaffected
- Fixes all channels through the shared renderer, not just Telegram

## Evidence

- Repro test in `extensions/telegram/src/format.test.ts` (fails without the fix): `边界：**社区显示：**Fable 与 **有效**。` now renders both bold spans
- New `packages/markdown-core/src/ir.emphasis-cjk.test.ts`: Chinese/Japanese/Korean cases plus regressions (ASCII `**bold** text`, intraword `foo**bar**baz`, code spans, links)
- Focused run: 2 files, 73 tests, all pass

- Type/lint/boundary validation after the type-fix commit: `pnpm tsgo:prod`, `pnpm tsgo:test`, `pnpm lint --threads=8`, `pnpm lint:extensions:channels`, `pnpm lint:extensions:bundled`, `pnpm test:extensions:package-boundary:compile`, `pnpm test:extensions:package-boundary:canary` — all pass locally at `92f28bf`


### Real behavior proof (terminal, production `markdownToIR`)

Run on the PR head with `node --import tsx` against `packages/markdown-core/src/ir.ts` (no test doubles — the exact parser production channels consume):

```
{"src":"边界：**社区显示：**Fable 与 **有效**。","renderedText":"边界：社区显示：Fable 与 有效。","boldSpans":["社区显示：","有效"]}
{"src":"前**加粗：**后","renderedText":"前加粗：后","boldSpans":["加粗："]}
{"src":"前**　加粗**后","renderedText":"前**　加粗**后","boldSpans":[]}
{"src":"前　**加粗**　后","renderedText":"前　加粗　后","boldSpans":["加粗"]}
{"src":"前** 加粗**后","renderedText":"前** 加粗**后","boldSpans":[]}
```

- Row 1 is the exact repro from #101120: both bold spans parse and no literal asterisks remain in rendered text.
- Rows 3/5: opening delimiters followed by U+3000 (ideographic space) / U+2009 (thin space) are correctly NOT forced open — the override now mirrors markdown-it's full Unicode whitespace classification (`isWhiteSpace`) before applying CJK-adjacent flags, addressing the review's shared-parser compatibility finding (`ir.ts` whitespace guard).
- Row 4: Unicode-space-separated emphasis keeps normal CommonMark behavior.

### Unicode-space regressions

Added in `ir.emphasis-cjk.test.ts`: U+3000 opener/separator cases and U+2009 opener/closer cases. Focused suite: 7/7 passing on the PR head.
